questions.prompt: Which host-plans components are in scope for the branch-option addition?
questions.description: Settled already (no need to pick): the file-vs-dir detection rule, one-level cap, project=repo / branch=git-branch defaults, and flat docs keeping working with no migration. This question is only about which code/doc surfaces we touch.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Core read path + gen_index branch walk + diagram surfacing + docs. The write path (new --branch) is only needed if you also want hand-authored PLANS to live under branches, not just generated diagrams — include it if so. check-validation is a nice-to-have.

options.label: plan-doc read path: glob gains projects/*/*/*.md, card() reports branch, resolve recurses one level
gen_index.py: branch-aware doc walk + branch grouping on the landing page
gen_index.py: surface generated diagrams/*.html on the landing page (serves the reuse goal)
plan-doc write path: new --branch <name> to author a branched plan doc
plan-doc check: validate branch dir names
AUTHORING.md + README: document the optional branch level

questions.prompt: How should the plans.claude landing page render branched docs?
questions.description: Today gen_index groups cards under one <h2> per project. Branches add a sub-dimension.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Nested: a per-branch sub-heading inside each project section. Keeps the project as the primary grouping and reads naturally for a few branches.

options.label: Nested — per-branch sub-heading under each project section
Flat — one card list per project, branch shown as a tag/pill on each card
Separate — each project/branch is its own top-level section

questions.prompt: If diagrams are surfaced in the index, how should they appear?
questions.description: Only relevant if 'diagram-surface' is in scope. Diagrams are generated .html with no frontmatter, so they have no title/status/date like .md cards.
questions.recommendedAnswer: A compact 'Diagrams' link-list under the matching project/branch (filename-derived labels), visually distinct from plan cards. Lightweight, no frontmatter needed.

options.label: Compact 'Diagrams' link-list under the project/branch (filename labels)
Full cards like docs (requires inventing title/date from filename + mtime)
Linked from the related plan doc's card, not as their own entries

questions.prompt: When a slug exists in more than one place (e.g. flat + branched, or two branches), how should plan-doc resolve it?
questions.description: Affects plan-doc resolve and the /plan:* skills that look docs up by bare slug.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Report ambiguity (current safe behavior) and accept explicit <branch>/<slug> addressing to disambiguate. Avoids silently picking the wrong doc.

options.label: Prefer the doc under the current git branch
